levels.description: Gain Ingredient Lore: an ingredient's details list every potion and poison it goes into.

effects.name: Ingredient Lore
effects.description: An ingredient's details list every potion and poison it goes into, by name and rarity. A recipe you don't know shows only that it exists, not its other ingredients.

levels.description: Forage finds something 10% more often, and a find of a common or uncommon ingredient brings one more.
Unlock Keen Harvest: your next forage is sure to find something, and rare and rarer ingredients weigh double in it. Outside battle, once per day.
